title: Six principles, six questions
caption: Each principle pairs a governing question with the metric that tests it. Infrastructure, communication, failure, serving contract, responsibility, sustainability — the fleet can bind at any layer.

title: The doubling arithmetic
caption: Doubling the cluster halves ideal step time and halves job MTBF in the same motion. Checkpoint overhead climbs; accelerator-hours rise even at perfect speedup. Capability and efficiency move in opposite directions.

title: The constraint migrates
caption: Each optimization shrinks one term and exposes the next. Compute gives way to fabric, fabric to recovery, recovery to serving tail, serving tail to governance. The binding constraint never disappears; it moves.

title: The fleet stack
caption: Physical substrate, distribution band, serving band, governance band. Each layer supplies the rates and obligations the next inherits.
